overview: Version 2: Fine-tuned 421M non-autoregressive decision model for ARC-AGI-2 and ARC-AGI-3 trained on 1720 cases.
usage:
# Model Usage

```python
import laya

agent = laya.Agent('/kaggle/input/arc-laya/transformers/typed-decisions/2', device='cuda')
prediction = agent.predict(state_representation, questions)
```

### Version 2 Performance
* Holdout Validation Accuracy: 89.92% (258 cases, 1290 decisions)
* Brier Calibration Score: 0.1020
* In-Distribution Latency (p50): 68.2ms
* Token Overhead: 0 tokens (non-autoregressive classification)
* System 1 Gating: Real ARC-AGI-2 taxonomy screening & ARC-AGI-3 deadlock / trap avoidance
